_about: Per-chain facts for the coop's contracts. Every usdc address here was VERIFIED ON-CHAIN (eth_chainId + symbol() + decimals()), never typed from a document or from memory — a token address taken on trust sends funds nowhere. Re-verify with `npm run verify:token:<net>` before trusting an edit.

local.note: No USDC here: the local chain uses a deployed MockUsdc stand-in. A real payment can never happen on this chain.

base-sepolia.note: Testnet. Proves the CHAIN side (deploy, gas, Safe, router, verification). It CANNOT prove the payment rail: the provider delivers USDC on Base mainnet only.

base.note: The coop's chain (DECIDED). The rail also delivers only here, so a real payment test is a mainnet test.
